messages:
Aisha: Quick sync — Ivy sandbox cohort: we still have 5 seats not confirmed and 3 customers flagged with early churn signals (low activity). Can we run a 45m office-hours drop-in for onboarding/first-week help tomorrow 11:00am PT? I can host but need a short survey to capture top friction + a canned invite message for AM outreach.
Jonah: 11am PT works for me. For the survey, keep 3 quick items: (1) what broke, (2) blocker severity (low/medium/high), (3) one improvement request. One-click radio buttons.
Maya: I can co-host the office hours. We should also add an option to book a 1:1 if they indicate high blocker severity.
Lee: Adding the troubleshooting doc to the thread: https://redwood.example/docs/onboard/troubleshoot-ivy — lean checklist we can paste during the session. Also tossing in a tiny Slack invite we can send to customers:```Hey — quick heads up: we’re running a 45m office-hours session tomorrow 11:00am PT to help with Ivy sandbox setup. Drop in or book a 1:1 here: <cal.link/ivy-office> — we’ll triage first-week issues and share quick fixes.```
Aisha: Perfect. Can someone draft the 3-question survey text? I’ll wire the invite and email cadence (day-of + 30m reminders). Also need a field in the survey to mark renewal risk: checkbox (At-risk) + freeform note.
Jonah: Draft survey copy below — feel free to tweak.```1) What issue are you seeing? (short text) 2) How is this impacting your work? (low/medium/high) 3) Would you like a 1:1? (Yes/No) [Optional] Add any notes: (text) [Checkbox] Mark for CS follow-up (At-risk)```
Maya: LGTM. I'll prepare a 2-slide quick-win deck (5 min) to show during the session: common tokenization pitfalls + SDK env variables.
Aisha: Can we add a small tracking tag so we can roll these responses into the cohort health doc? Suggest tag: "ivy-office-2026-q1". Also create a Trello task for each at-risk response so CS can own follow-ups.
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled — office-hours invite will be posted to cohort channels 1 hour before start.
Lee: Small ops note — if anyone needs logs during the call, run:```rsi collect --cohort ivy --since 24h```and paste the output link. We'll anonymize tokens before sharing.
Aisha: Thanks team — I'll send invites now and add the survey form link. Post-call, please drop one-line outcomes into #customer-success for the renewal risk triage. :thumbsup:
